scope: Repair PPO masked minibatch loss normalization; paired learning-rate comparison with identical physical environment and initial weights
authorization: User requests improve pure reinforcement learning through experiments before adding any world model
transition_unit: one environment control step, not individual robot samples
comparability: Both arms start from identical per-seed EXP29 500K actor/critic, with fresh optimizer/RNG/environment/counters, matched training layout streams. Only actor learning rate differs between A and B; PPO normalization repaired in both. Historical EXP29 is not a matched continuation control.
task_limit: Controlled in-vitro goal-conditioned ideal-actuator simulation with perfect state. All object positions randomized on fixed MCA anatomy. Soft overlap costs, not hard collision physics. Diagnostic clearance feasibility is not collision-free policy performance or hardware verification.
dashboard_message: EXP30纯RL修正筛选：修复PPO小批次归一化，A原学习率/B降低actor学习率。环境与碰撞指标不变，尚未证明达到80%。
study_stage: screening; 20 paired development layouts, not final success evidence
